scope: Static installed-client curve helper tracing; not runtime or server parity

findings.subject: GetValueAtLevel
findings.finding: The reflected wrapper forwards the supplied level to a helper. With its subsystem available, the helper requests an overridden scalable float before evaluation; otherwise it evaluates the original binding. The override routine can return either the original binding or a replacement. Its diagnostic string identifies PredCurveTableOverrideSubsystem.
findings.remaining: Recover subsystem configuration, override source and selection conditions. Do not assume packaged curve rows are always effective runtime values.

findings.subject: Scalable float evaluation
findings.status: native arithmetic traced; virtual curve evaluator unresolved
findings.finding: The resolved-curve branch passes the supplied level to a virtual curve evaluator and multiplies the result by the scalable coefficient. The branch with no row-name binding returns the coefficient; a named but unresolved curve is a different path. Registry and error paths are separate.
findings.remaining: Resolve virtual dispatch and endpoint/extrapolation semantics; validate missing-row and registry cases before implementing a general evaluator.

findings.subject: Knell, Combustion and Sky Splitter
findings.status: serialized curve bindings recovered; effective values incomplete
findings.finding: Exact property spans identify the named curves for Knell shred, per-level shred and steal; Combustion damage, scaling, radius and cooldown reduction; Sky Splitter ranged/melee percent health, floor and monster cap.
findings.remaining: Combine resolved object paths, curve data, override selection, effect defaults and event scaling before claiming complete production behavior.

validation: Bounded direct-control-flow traversal follows conditional branches beyond an early return and records calls without executing them.
Synthetic tests cover conditional branches, direct loops, indirect jumps, overlap, budget exhaustion and unmapped targets.
limits: Static reachability does not prove runtime execution.
Calls and indirect dispatch remain unresolved dependencies.
Exception-directory ranges can be fragments; stopping at their first boundary loses reachable code.
All native instruction traces, detailed addresses and decoded bodies remain private.
